review.description: S4 preserves the target single Make worker graph, once-per-invocation phony preparation, fresh independent inputs, ordered fail-fast verification, standalone keep-going and native flags/variable flavors/direct forwarding. S4/S5 add versioned bounded monotonic phase evidence; S5 finalizes immediately after exact verification/provenance before every upload, with timing upload last. Existing adoption pins and acceptance gaps remain unchanged. Supported manual main setup failures now retain the verifier existing HEAD-parent identity; local SIGINT/SIGTERM during metadata collection finalizes interrupted evidence before the worker starts. Feature-route rejection prevents source checks and verified build/package artifacts while partial timing summaries may remain. Source identity now reflects exact Git-enumerated names, including leading whitespace, and unambiguously distinguishes arbitrary binary contents and adjacent file records at unchanged HEAD and dirty state. No raw input names or contents are exported. Interrupted startup now retains the actual worker comparison even when outer FLOW_ARGS differs, main has advanced and the journal was preselected. Native GNU Make pipe jobservers retain their caller parallelism across timing, alongside FIFO/default behavior. Fresh and selected local startup interruptions retain truthful partial journals while source/comparison fields are still unknown. Actual worker-native FLOW_ARGS, including recursive assignments, target-specific values and MAKELEVEL, select the recorded comparison before version queries or source/build verification. Hosted dispatch retains the exact already-validated comparison and startup source snapshot through refresh, interruption, worker success/failure and finalization for ordinary push, PR, manual main and reviewed-root routes. Target integration now compares against c5eab656516393f8673e86a15b3f8bb5e161f9eb: PR24 feature-partitioned browser correctness uses two independent mocked workers/fresh contexts, one ordered assembled worker, zero retries and per-test accessibility evidence. The optional alternating serial/two-worker benchmark remains separate from full verification and isolated launch performance.
review.implementation: Reviewed both target 470ada0 and integrated Makefile/verify.sh/ci.py/timing helper/workflow. Make remains the dependency and ordering owner; one owned timing boundary observes the graph and fixed allowlisted leaf commands record actual execution, including hosted Python/browser prerequisites. There is no Python per-phase Make loop or workflow-side installation. The existing process runner owns cancellation cleanup; journal writes fail open. Timing stays outside browser samples and separate from reconciliation seconds. Dry-run detection now reads the first parsed short-option cluster and excludes GNU argument options, so n inside include paths or output modes does not bypass journals. Cycle 1 review inspected hosted_comparison delegating manual/root selection to ci.comparison, preserving main-only eligibility and the pinned reviewed root without fabricating HEAD^. verify now encloses journal creation/export, comparison and toolchain refresh within its existing cancellation/finalization boundary. No new subprocess or process-group policy was added; existing graph, flags and artifact ordering remain unchanged. Cycle 2 inspected every timing git() caller: the helper returns exact bytes, ls-files -z keeps raw NUL boundaries, and SHA/comparison text is explicitly normalized at text call sites; boolean status remains unchanged. Hash records include their field count, typed file/link/absence tag, exact path, mode/target/content fields and each field length, preventing content from impersonating a neighboring record. This is internal hashing only; journal schema, privacy, runtime ownership and orchestration remain unchanged. Cycle 3 inspected actual argument selection (last worker FLOW_ARGS assignment), initial journal comparison, and separate durable comparison transaction before toolchain queries. The private owned runner adds optional explicit pass_fds only; timing validates advertised pipe pairs for open non-stdio read/write ends on one FIFO inode, rejects invalid/closed/non-pipe/mismatched descriptors, and leaves FIFO auth to native Make. All other descriptors stay closed, other callers keep their original default call, and existing session/group/signal/timeout ownership is unchanged. Cycle 4 inspected Journal.create(metadata=False), collect_metadata and verify: initial allowlisted JSON is written with null source/unavailable comparison, and verify owns its handle before metadata can interrupt. Separate field updates invalidate obsolete identity, preserve completed source/comparison fields and allow finally to mark interrupted with finite wall time. The private worker-start action runs in the existing single Make worker as a shared first verification-context phony prerequisite for verify, bootstrap and both hosted graph roots; Make exports its actual resolved FLOW_ARGS there. Outer native route defers optional metadata; direct Python calls keep last-argv handling. No extra Make invocation, variable evaluator, scheduler or process policy is introduced. Hosted setup-pinned identity, normal write-failure fail-open, FIFO/pipe forwarding, fixture forcing, dry-run and graph ordering remain preserved. Post-cap recovery inspected every production refresh caller: ci.run_verification now supplies an explicit keyword-only plan while local verify passes text and worker-start reads native context. Journal.refresh(plan=...) commits only the validated hosted comparison before toolchain queries, avoiding source invalidation/recollection and text parsing; plan=None preserves all local startup behavior. The source, timing schema, artifact ordering, bootstrap eligibility, flags/jobservers and process lifecycle policies remain unchanged. Rebased all six947 timing commits onto exactc5 without dropping unique work. Compared final timing.py/ci.py/Makefile/verify.sh/processes.py and timing/runner tests byte-for-byte with approved947; semantics unchanged. Target web tests, Playwright config, helpers, benchmark workflow, PyYAML requirements and UI assertion registry remain exactly target bytes, including deletion of factory.spec.ts. Merged catalog using old470/targetc5/approved947 semantic three-way comparison; rebuilt complete authored docs from947 plus exact target browser sections, then rendered generated references. scripts/test_ci.py contains exactly947 plus target yaml import/benchmark fixture. No browser scheduler/product behavior/process or metadata interface change.
review.tests: Inspected preserved recorder assertions for shared/fresh prerequisites, output digests, serial -j execution, every phase failure under -k, assigned/inherited MAKEFLAGS, literal dollars/flavors, native dry runs and exact hosted/bootstrap dispatch. New real-adapter assertions inspect successful/failed/null-unstarted journals and SIGTERM cleanup; the production workflow assertion rejects the original finalizer-after-upload ordering. Timing tests inspect overlap/parentage, concurrent writers, row bounds, privacy, immutable source identity and fail-open status. CI environment/cache fixtures now understand the real adapter while preserving fixture forcing and uncached race-test assertions; test fixtures clear enclosing journal context. The real malformed-metadata bootstrap regression verifies an unavailable private comparison cannot terminate the worker or replace its nonzero status, with no private diagnostic output. Reviewed the real graph option-argument regression across direct/inherited/assigned flags and -n; forced graph/probe assertion failures, a stopped wrapper fallback and early writer failure prove termination, owned-group cleanup and reaping. The shared test-only cleanup freezes the wrapper before signalling direct owned child groups; production detached-process guarantees remain unchanged. Read the actual temporary two-commit manual setup-failure assertion, pinned/unreviewed/feature-root guards, malformed manual metadata privacy fallback, and actual ci.main rejected feature path that invokes neither verification nor package manifest creation but finalizes a partial journal. Real SIGINT/SIGTERM probes block tool-version collection, require unchanged130/143 exit status, finite interrupted wall time, null unstarted phases, no worker marker, and bounded pidfd termination. Existing owned-graph cleanup assertions remain intact; immediate metadata zombie disappearance is not claimed. Read eight real-Git tracked/untracked whitespace-prefix cases that require raw first filename bytes, content-dependent digests at identical HEAD+dirty=true, ignored journal stability and no private data export. The exact staged-deletion/binary-NUL counterexample now produces distinct hashes; file/link/absence/mode and staging invariance assertions preserve existing distinctions. Text SHA/head/merge-base outputs remain normalized. Separate mutation runs reject both the old stripping behavior and old NUL-concatenated record scheme. Read fresh/preselected real SIGINT/SIGTERM probes on diverged main: actual worker merge-base/head identity is persisted before metadata blocks, status130/143 and interrupted wall/unstarted phases survive with no worker marker. Read native Make4.4.1 default/FIFO/explicit-pipe and retained4.3 default-pipe graph probes with direct/inherited/assigned flags, no unavailable fallback and one shared preparation. Real runner descriptor probes preserve only explicit capabilities, fixture0, exit37, handler restoration and legacy default kwargs; selector cases reject unrelated/invalid/closed/non-pipe/stdio/overflow inputs. Existing flag/flavor/dry-run/fail-fast and owned cleanup regressions pass, and mutation proofs reject both old failure paths. Read deterministic KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit143 and real SIGINT/SIGTERM probes at source and comparison collection for fresh/preselected journals: initial JSON exists before readiness, unknown source is null and comparison unavailable, completed source survives, status130/143 and interrupted wall time persist, all phases remain unstarted/null and no worker starts. Mutation reproducing pre-persistence identity is rejected. Read actual native graph regression: recursive/simple assignment order, quotes, duplicate last assignment, direct entry and ci override match both worker specs.py argv and resolved journal. A child MAKELEVEL plus target-specific recursive value rejects outer-context approximation; fake version queries assert comparison is already resolved and no verification command has run. Restoring outer raw-argv selection and omitting the native context prerequisite fails this test. Private worker-start instrumentation errors retain fixed private diagnostics and return0; existing runner/default flags/dollars/dryruns/jobserver/cancellation assertions remain required. New actual-dispatch regression covers push/PR/manual/bootstrap x status0/23 using real selected Journal refresh, a real fixture command and hosted finalization. It asserts exact comparison, preserved initial source, no source recollection/text parse, fixture0, authoritative status, final outcome/wall time and no warning. A separate real-dispatch boundary probe raises KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit143 from version collection after asserting the comparison is already durable; no worker starts and interrupted finalization retains both identities. Exact original c0 modules reject these tests with10 failures in an isolated copy. Existing27 timing tests and16 hosted/native fixtures pass; full reconciliation and separate localCI refresh all required mapped assertions. Read target benchmark test executing actual YAML Bash with fake npx: worker1/2/1/2, zero retries, JSON and per-process RSS output, immediate exit19 stop. Read target config bounded2mocked/1assembled/zero-retry and three original assembled scenario order; fresh page/host state and per-test Axe outputPath/attach remain in target helpers.
